attributes.action: STOP THE NEW REFUGEE SPONSORSHIP ROUTE INTO THE UK. CLOSE THE BORDERS!
attributes.additional_details:
In 2024 the Labour Party's manifesto promised to 'Restore Hope' to 'Stop the Chaos','Rebuild our Country' and to 'Take back our streets'. 
In two years Labour Gov. failed so badly the PM was forced to resign. They killed the British hope, they caused more chaos, they destroyed the country and made the streets 500% worse by letting in rapists and murderers, in the thousands.
The sponsorship of asylums is just another way of letting in more unwanted 3rd world foreigners and it must be STOPPED!
attributes.background: On the 26th June 2026, Shabana Mahmood annouced a new process which will allow Asylum seekers into the UK by way of sponsorship. The British people did NOT ask for this, the British people did NOT vote for this and the British People do NOT want this. The British want this borders CLOSED.
